screen.ultraboost.title: UltraBoost
option.ultraboost.enabled.tooltip: Toggle the UltraBoost performance layer on or off.
option.ultraboost.smart_entity_culling.t: Skip far or hidden entities before they are rendered.
option.ultraboost.entity_culling_range.t: Maximum range for culling entities in blocks.
option.ultraboost.frustum_culling.toolti: Avoid rendering entities outside the visible camera volume.
option.ultraboost.particle_reduction.too: Reduce particle count and visual spam.
option.ultraboost.max_particles.tooltip: Maximum particle count before limiting begins.
option.ultraboost.dynamic_simulation_dis: Lower simulation distance when the scene is heavy.
option.ultraboost.simulation_distance.to: Simulation distance in chunks when active.
option.ultraboost.fps_limiter_enabled.to: Apply a target FPS ceiling when enabled.
option.ultraboost.reduce_weather.tooltip: Lower weather visual cost and particle load.
option.ultraboost.reduce_clouds.tooltip: Reduce cloud complexity and visual overhead.
option.ultraboost.entity_update_throttle: Millisecond delay used for entity update throttling.
option.ultraboost.render_scale_enabled.t: Enable a reduced render scale to lower GPU usage.
option.ultraboost.render_scale.tooltip: Render scale multiplier. Lower means lighter load.
option.ultraboost.fast_fog.tooltip: Use cheaper fog setup for smoother rendering.
